name: India: NBC 2016 and labour law
about: What Indian codes ask of a building's people, as checks and ratios a firm's standards name: WCs for the staff of an office (NBC 2016, Part 9: 1 for every 25 men and 1 for every 15 women; an even split is taken, so about 1 for every 19 people), a cleaner's sink on every floor (NBC 2016), a crèche for an establishment of 50 or more employees (Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act 2017), an accessible toilet on every floor that has people. Notes only; a project takes one off where it does not apply (a crèche shared within a short distance).

ratios.name: WCs (NBC 2016: staff, 1 per 25 men and 1 per 15 women; an even split)

checks.say: {level_name} seats about {people} people and has no toilets: give the floor its own (NBC 2016 counts them by the people they serve).
{level_name} has no janitor's room: NBC 2016 asks for a cleaner's sink on every floor.
{level_name} has no accessible toilet: a wheelchair user working on this floor needs one on it.

About {people} people work here and there is no crèche: the Maternity Benefit Act (2017 amendment) asks for one from 50 employees, here or within a short distance (if it is elsewhere, take this note off for the project).
